thread:
maria-tech: Heads-up — seeing a ~3m spike of 504s on /api/generate starting ~09:12 UTC. Can someone point me to the dashboards/traces/logs to start triage? Suspect batch queueing but not sure. Request-id header present on some samples.

jonathan-sre: Dashboards: Grafana -> Inference -> Route Errors: https://grafana.redwood.io/d/inf-route-errors. For batch/queue metrics: https://grafana.redwood.io/d/inf-queue-metrics. Traces: Tempo -> service=proxy, look for queue_wait spans. Logs: Kibana -> logs-*-ingest, filter by request_id or http.path.

deploy-bot: Deploy to inference-prod finished at 09:08 UTC (commit 2f9a7bd). :shipit:

ashley-eng: I can take traces. If you can paste a sample request_id I’ll grab flamegraph and KV/cache timings.

maria-tech: sample req id = 01a2b3c4. Also seeing elevated batch_wait_ms in metrics for pod group 'gen-v2'.

jonathan-sre: Quick steps: 1) Check gen-v2 queue_length + batch_size panels (grafana link above). 2) Query spans with tags batch_wait_ms, queue_length. Example Jaeger/Tempo query: service=gen-runtime and tag:request_id=01a2b3c4. CLI to pull traces:

curl -s "https://tempo.redwood.io/api/traces?service=gen-runtime&lookback=1h&query=request_id:01a2b3c4"

liz-devex: FYI if this is transient we should avoid paging SRE — suggest escalate if >5m or error rate >2% for 5m. Can we bump alert debounce from 2m -> 5m?

jonathan-sre: Agreed. I'll open a small alert PR to increase debounce and filter to route=/api/generate. Will also add suppression for deploy windows if deploy bot annotates.

deploy-bot: Deploy annotation: inference-prod @09:08 UTC by ashley-eng, change: batching param on gen-v2. :thinking_face:

ashley-eng: Yep that was a small batching param tweak to gen-v2 to reduce tail latency — rolling back now, will notify when done.

maria-tech: rollback in progress. thanks all. pls attach trace links when you have them.

jonathan-sre: Trace link: https://tempo.redwood.io/trace/abcd1234 (span shows queue_wait_ms ~220ms). Kibana sample: https://kibana.redwood.io/app/discover#/doc/01a2b3c4 . Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.io/runbooks/inference-timeouts

ashley-eng: Rollback done, error rate dropping :thumbsup:. I'll run a quick validation.

maria-tech: thanks! will monitor for 30m and reopen if it resurfaces. pinging @ashley-eng for CR to revert batching config.
